text:
erin: Heads-up: Finance + Product approved a consumer fair-use and invoice-clarity update. Enforcement 2026-10-01. Purpose: clearer billing, fewer surprise drains on free trials, and simpler invoices for customer accounting. Quick summary below.

sam: Can you share the concrete changes so product/docs can prep copy?

erin: Sure. Major points: 
1) Free trial & free-tier tokens will be renamed to "monthly credit bundle" and capped by default at 75k tokens.
2) Trial-to-paid behavior: trial bundles convert to a 30-day trial bucket (no rolling monthly credit) after signup.
3) We'll stop silently applying small promo top-ups ("token bursaries"); going forward promos are explicit, time-bound, and appear as separate invoice adjustments.

maya: How will customers see this in the Console and invoices?

erin: Console: banner with chorded thresholds (50% advisory, 90% urgent), plus a new line in the usage panel that shows "bundle remaining". Invoices: line groups will be: BASE_QUOTA, EXTRAS (token bundles/top-ups), and ADJUSTMENTS (promo credits/refunds).

finance-bot: Note: invoice preview run for impacted buckets scheduled 2026-10-02T04:00Z.

sam: Any header/API changes for engineering? We should avoid breaking SDKs.

erin: No breaking changes. We'll add optional headers: `x-bundle-remaining`, `x-invoice-group-id`. We will also introduce `x-pro-rata-topup` when a preemptive topup is suggested. 429 semantics unchanged; advisory 429s will include `x-advisory=true`.

ops: Engineering: need a flag `bundle_type` and `promo_topup_id` in account metadata, plus an event `billing_bundle_exhausted`. We'll open infra tasks for the backfill.

maya: Support requests: please give us a quick playbook for customers who see new grouped invoice lines, and a canned response for promo-to-adjustment clarifications. Also want a one-click console CTA to convert a trial bundle into a paid subscription.

support: We'll create the playbook and the canned responses. Also request a debug column `last_bundle_topup` for support agents.

erin: Marketing will position this as "simpler invoices, clearer credits" and we'll emphasize transparency. Avoid language about price increases.

sam: What about overage handling and grace windows? Any changes?

erin: Yes: pay-as-you-go accounts keep a 72-hour grace window before hard throttle. Free/trial bundle accounts get a 48-hour advisory then a 24-hour cooling period on sustained overage before hard throttle. We'll send an email 48 hours into sustained overage and include an invoice estimate.

finance-bot: Action: flag accounts with >2 consecutive months of overage for targeted outreach on 2026-09-15.

ops: We'll need migrations to recompute `monthly_bundle_snapshots` and to tag affected accounts with `bundle_deprecation_notice_sent`. Scheduled job 2026-09-20T02:00Z.

maya: Any legal/TOS text changes? We should surface the cooling period and promo adjustment behavior.

erin: Legal will provide a short amendment. Also: promos will require explicit consent in the Console before application.

support: One more ask: add a Console tooltip on invoice line groups that expands with an explanation and a link to the CSV export for accounting. That should cut down on billing tickets.

erin: Agreed. Timeline: 2026-09-01 internal comms -> 2026-09-10 customer previews -> 2026-10-01 enforcement. We'll publish the public Help Center article 2026-09-10.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a docs freeze and tag the PR for the Console copy.

erin: Thanks all. billing-bot: schedule invoice preview and send reminder to finance for samples. :shipit:

finance-bot: Invoice preview scheduled 2026-10-02T04:00Z. Samples to be delivered to billing-review@redwood.ai by 2026-09-25.
